name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

meta.wiki: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

summary: Hansel Heavyhands says his bunions have bunions, and he cannot do any killing with his feet in such disarray. Scrange and Burninate told him to clear out the incendosaurs of the Slag Pit, so he sends you instead to slay twenty.

sections.title: Bunions upon Bunions
sections.body: Hansel Heavyhands is in no state to fight. Scrange and Burninate told him to kill the incendosaurs so that expeditionary teams can go down into the lava pools of the Slag Pit and explore. Hansel passes the work on to you.

sections.title: The Lava Pools
sections.body: The incendosaurs occupy the lava pools down in the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron. Hansel wants twenty slain, and does not want to see you back until you have done it.

faq.answer: He is the one who gives you this job in the Searing Gorge. Scrange and Burninate told him to deal with the incendosaurs, but he cannot with his bunions.

faq.q: Why do the incendosaurs need to be cleared out?
faq.answer: Scrange and Burninate want expeditionary teams to explore the lava pools of the Slag Pit. Incendosaurs there are said to be causing all kinds of problems.
Down in the lava pools of the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron.

faq.q: Why won't Hansel hunt them himself?
faq.answer: His bunions have bunions, he says, and his feet are in too much disarray for any killing.
